name: – Joachim Stanisław Brudziński – After § 1 – Am 2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section VII – Committee of the Regions
part_text: 1a. Observes a 6,1% increase in the final budget for 2023 compared with 2022 that follows a 3,0% increase for 2022 compared with 2021; is concerned by these constant increases;
